title: Spatial Atlas: Compute-Grounded Reasoning for Spatial-Aware Research Agent Benchmarks
abstract: arXiv:2604.12102v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: We describe compute-grounded reasoning (CGR), a design pattern in which code computes selected sub-problems from explicit intermediate representations before a language model answers. Spatial Atlas implements CGR as an Agent2Agent (A2A) server with a spatial question-answering handler and a machine-learning engineering handler. The spatial handler asks a language model to extract a scene graph, and code then fills in missing distances and checks the extracted safety rules. A separate benchmark driver can also run a strict metric bridge. It computes the gap for horizontal-gap questions from segmentation masks and a reconstructed point map, and it passes that gap to the answering model as a fact. The bridge returns a fixed unavailable answer when an evidence check fails, and it never falls back to model-estimated coordinates. translated_title: Spatial Atlas：面向空间感知研究智能体基准的计算支撑推理
translated_abstract: 我们描述了计算支撑推理（CGR），这是一种设计模式：在语言模型给出回答之前，由代码基于显式的中间表示来计算选定的子问题。Spatial Atlas 将 CGR 实现为一个 Agent2Agent（A2A）服务器，包含一个空间问答处理器和一个机器学习工程处理器。空间处理器让语言模型提取场景图，随后由代码填补缺失的距离并检查提取出的安全规则。一个独立的基准测试驱动程序还可以运行严格的度量桥接：它根据分割掩码和重建的点云图计算水平间隔问题的间隔值，并将该间隔作为事实传递给回答模型。当证据检查失败时，该桥接会返回固定的“不可用”答案，并且绝不会回退到模型估计的坐标。机器学习工程处理器生成流水线代码、解析验证分数，并限制修复与（原文在此处截断）……
tldr: 该论文提出“计算支撑推理”（CGR）设计模式，即在语言模型回答前由代码基于显式中间表示计算选定子问题，并在 Spatial Atlas 系统中以 A2A 服务器形式实现空间问答与机器学习工程两个处理器，从而为空间感知研究智能体基准提供更可靠、不回退于模型猜测的度量方式。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces compute-grounded reasoning (CGR), a design pattern where code computes selected sub-problems from explicit intermediate representations before the language model answers, implemented in Spatial Atlas as an A2A server with spatial question-answering and ML-engineering handlers to enable more reliable spatial-aware research agent benchmarks.
